label-position.description: The position of the form field label, if the value is left or right, you need to set label-width
label-position.description_zh: 表单域标签的位置，如果值为 left 或者 right 时，则需要设置 label-width

label-width.description: The width of the form field label, e.g. '50px'. The form-item that is a direct child of the Form inherits the value. Auto is supported.
label-width.description_zh: 表单域标签的宽度，例如 '50px'。作为 Form 直接子元素的 form-item 会继承该值。支持 auto。

label-suffix.description: The suffix of the form field label

showIcon.description: Whether or not to display the icon

hide-required-asterisk.description: Whether to hide the red asterisk next to the label of the required field
hide-required-asterisk.description_zh: 是否隐藏必填字段的标签旁边的红色星号

require-asterisk-position.description: The position of the red asterisk

show-message.description: Whether a verification error message is displayed
show-message.description_zh: 是否显示校验错误信息

inline-message.description: Displays the validation information in an inline form
inline-message.description_zh: 以行内形式展示校验信息

status-icon.description: Whether to display the verification result feedback icon in the input box
status-icon.description_zh: 是否在输入框中显示校验结果反馈图标

validate-on-rule-change.description: Whether to display the verification result feedback icon in the input box
validate-on-rule-change.description_zh: 是否在输入框中显示校验结果反馈图标

size.description: Used to control the size of the components within the form
size.description_zh: 用于控制该表单内组件的尺寸

disabled.description: Whether to disable all components within the form. If set to true, the disabled attribute on the component in the form no longer takes effect
disabled.description_zh: 是否禁用该表单内的所有组件。若设置为 true，则表单内组件上的 disabled 属性不再生效

scroll-to-error.description: Whether to scroll to the first error location when the form is validated
scroll-to-error.description_zh: 校验表单时是否滚动到第一个错误的位置

scroll-into-view-options.description: When the verification fails, scroll to the first failed form item. Can be configured through scrollIntoView
scroll-into-view-options.description_zh: 当校验有失败结果时，滚动到第一个失败的表单项目 可通过 scrollIntoView 配置

events.name: validate
events.description: An event that is triggered when an alert is closed

exposed.name: validate
exposed.description: 对整个表单的内容进行验证。 接收一个回调函数，或返回 Promise。
exposed.description_zh: 对整个表单的内容进行验证。 接收一个回调函数，或返回 Promise。

exposed.name: validateField
exposed.detail: (props?: Arrayable<FormItemProp> | undefined, callback?: FormValidateCallback | undefined) => FormValidationResult

exposed.name: resetFields
exposed.description: 重置该表单项，将其值重置为初始值，并移除校验结果
exposed.description_zh: 重置该表单项，将其值重置为初始值，并移除校验结果

exposed.name: clearValidate
exposed.description: 清理某个字段的表单验证信息。
exposed.description_zh: 清理某个字段的表单验证信息。
